title: Original mounted sounds and volume
change: Added a bounded Bevy audio backend with 22 authored one-shot event rows and asynchronous asset preparation
steps: After startup fire pistol .357 SMG AR2 shotgun crossbow RPG crowbar and stunstick. Reload supported guns. Use a valid tool action and cause an explosion. Open Q Player to adjust Audio volume
expected: Accepted actions play original installed sounds after their assets are ready. Volume zero mutes. Q F7 F8 pause focus loss death and scene restoration clear transient audio
limits: Not sounds for everything. Flechette and grenade throw cues several reloads physgun loops footsteps vehicle engines NPC voices menu sounds and native script channels DSP remain open. First events before preload completes are dropped

title: Prop impact sound and optional shake
change: Props now request impact feedback from force and approach-speed thresholds with cooldown and distance falloff
steps: Drop props nearby and farther away. Use Physical Properties to compare metal wood and glass. Let a stack rest. Open Q Player and toggle Impact shake. Save and restore the scene
expected: Moving impacts can play material-override cues and bounded decaying camera shake. Resting contacts should not chatter. Disabling shake leaves sound enabled. Aim rays and movement are unchanged
limits: Original model surfaces and struck-surface pairs are not inferred. Unmapped materials use an explicit generic metal cue. Thresholds panning and shake are independent approximations requiring your checks

title: Finger Poser and Inflator
change: Compatible model props now deform through their original weighted skeleton with per-instance meshes
steps: Spawn a humanoid model as a prop rather than an NPC. Select Finger Poser and choose hand finger joint curl and splay. Apply with LMB sample with RMB reset with R. Try Inflator on different body regions
expected: Only the selected prop changes. Inflator LMB grows and RMB shrinks the nearest weighted bone group. R resets scales. Color and material edits remain supported
limits: Single convex prop collision is rebuilt. This is not articulated ragdoll physics. ValveBiped fingers only. Native axis calibration scale inheritance and NPC support remain open

title: Face Poser and Eye Poser
change: Original flex deltas and explicit iris textures now support manual per-instance posing
steps: Spawn a compatible face model as a prop. Choose a raw descriptor and weight for Face Poser then LMB apply RMB sample R reset. Eye Poser LMB selects then LMB targets a point. RMB looks at you and R resets
expected: Status identifies the chosen flex. Eye targets remain relative to the prop. Unsupported metadata or materials produce an error rather than placeholder success
limits: Raw descriptors are not native flex controllers. Native named widgets presets wrinkles cornea shading eyelids strabismus and NPC integration remain open

title: Poses in undo copies and saved scenes
change: Version-6 scenes serialize bone rotations scales raw flex weights and local eye targets
steps: Pose one of two identical props. Save and reload. Duplicate the posed prop. Remove and undo. Try recoloring and resetting material. Switch away after selecting eyes
expected: Supported poses use instance-local meshes and restored modifiers. Old scene versions remain readable. Invalid pose data is preflighted before scene replacement
limits: All visual model compatibility and lifecycle checks await your acceptance. No gameplay tests have been run. Whole-scene undo still rewinds unrelated movement

title: Construction devices and key groups
change: Balloons buttons dynamite emitters hoverballs lights lamps thrusters and wheels now have independent typed implementations
steps: Select each tool in Q. Inspect its controls. Try left and right actions. Use the configured numpad keys and E on buttons. Save and undo
expected: Devices use actual forces joints lights or timed effects. Edit Entity samples supported settings. Connected copies retain configuration
limits: Partial native behavior only. Emitter supports sparks. Lights do not relight unlit model materials. Dynamite has no player damage. Axle changes require a new wheel

title: Powered joints and pulley
change: Motor hydraulic muscle winch and four-anchor pulley now have bounded physical implementations
steps: Connect movable props. Try each configured key and toggle. For pulley select a prop then two world guides then the second prop. R removes constraints
expected: Motor rotates. Hydraulic changes target length. Muscle oscillates. Winch changes rope limit. Pulley couples endpoint travel
limits: Independent Rapier and force controllers are not native solver parity. Force breaking cable materials ghost previews and exact tuning remain open

title: Paint and moving trails
change: Paint stores textured surface marks and Trails builds bounded historical ribbons
steps: Paint a prop and wall. Move the prop. Add a trail and move again. Remove with R. Undo then save and reload
expected: Paint follows props and saves. Trail settings survive restoration while history restarts. Limits prevent unbounded geometry
limits: Paint is a quad not a clipped projected decal. Reload on the world removes all world paint. Native UV fade spray effects and sounds remain open

title: Place and use remote cameras
change: Camera tool creates a frozen view with configurable numpad activation and FOV
steps: Left-click a surface to place a camera at your eye or right-click to aim it at that fixed point. Move away then press its numpad key. Open F8 and return
expected: Remote view hides hands and prevents player movement shooting physgun actions and vehicle entry. Key toggles back to player view
limits: Fixed look point only. Moving-entity tracking native lock semantics and transition fidelity remain open. Restore resets transient activation and fuses

title: Sprint and precision flight
change: V noclip now applies sheet-authored speed modifiers with world-up vertical controls
steps: Press V then fly with WASD. Hold either Shift for boost or either Alt for precision. Use Space and either Ctrl while looking up and down. Open F8 and type
expected: Shift doubles base speed. Alt uses one quarter speed and overrides Shift. Vertical controls do not tilt with the camera. Typing does not move you
limits: Independent immediate-stop flight handling. Native acceleration friction and command speed equivalence remain unmeasured

title: Right-click aiming and gun recoil
change: All eight enabled guns now have sheet-authored custom hold-RMB aim and accepted-shot camera punch plus model kick
steps: Equip pistol .357 SMG AR2 shotgun crossbow RPG and flechette in turn. Release buttons then hold RMB and fire. Reload. Open menus. Try aiming from F4
expected: Zoom sensitivity and hands offsets blend while aiming. Recoil is bounded and recovers. Reload menus switching death and vehicles clear aim. F4 view returns after releasing aim
limits: Custom universal aim is not native secondary-fire parity. Exact iron-sight alignment still needs per-model calibration. Disabled guns remain disabled. Sounds and native secondary attacks remain open

title: Latest feedback regression repairs
change: Corrected wheel coordinate conversion crouch acceleration lock third-person weapon bone merging and ring-biased bullet spread
steps: Drive Jeep forward and reverse then inspect F4. Crouch across flat ground and release movement. Walk and crouch with physgun and pistol in F4. Fire SMG at a wall
expected: Wheel spin uses the actual model basis. Crouch reaches its authored speed. Weapons follow named player bones. Shots sample inside the spread cone rather than only its rim
limits: These are repaired code paths awaiting your checks. Native suspension aim-pose layers recoil RNG and weapon hold-type coverage remain partial

title: Rotate held props with E and mouse
change: Replaced timed E-key yaw with camera-relative mouse rotation around the grab point
steps: Hold a prop with LMB then hold E and move the mouse horizontally and vertically. Keep E held without moving. Release E and move the camera. Freeze and undo
expected: Mouse rotates the held prop while view direction stays fixed. No mouse movement means no automatic spin. Grab point remains stable
limits: Native Shift angle snapping roll mode and collision-constrained angular motion remain unfinished

title: Tool availability is not full native parity

steps: Check each tool action and report its ID plus left right or reload behavior through F8. Read its limits and compare F7 checks
expected: 35 partial entries and three reference-only internal entries. The 178 authored option rows and 52 manual tool cases describe the current subset
limits: Native ragdolls facial controller rules sounds full settings solver fidelity menus weapons NPCs and the broader parity backlog remain incomplete

title: Crouch and jump-crouch
change: Ctrl changes collision height camera eye and movement speed with original directional crouch clips
steps: Hold either Ctrl on clear ground. Walk in eight directions. Jump then crouch. Release under a low ceiling and move clear. Inspect with F4
expected: Feet stay planted on grounded duck. Air duck raises feet. Standing waits for clearance. Crouch slows movement and animates
limits: Native box hull command timing duck-jump interpolation and crouch jump boost remain incomplete. These checks are not yet accepted

title: Bullet impact marks and bursts
change: Hit normals place bounded original concrete-texture marks with short visible bursts
steps: Shoot a wall and movable prop with the pistol or .357. Move the prop and wait for marks to expire. Try a rocket
expected: Marks follow struck props and expire. Explosions have a short burst. Marks do not replace prop materials
limits: Generic texture quads are not native projected decals. Material-specific sounds blood dust scorch effects clipping and saved marks remain open

title: Vehicle wheel motion and crash feedback
change: Jeep Jalopy and APC use researched wheel attachments and radii for roll and front steering with contact-force bursts
steps: Spawn each car. Drive forward reverse and steer. Inspect with F4. Hit a wall then stop. Save a recolored car and reload
expected: Wheel roll follows signed speed and front wheels follow steering. Strong contacts request a cooldown-limited burst. Saved appearance remains intact
limits: No native wheel pose parameters suspension deformation crash damage engine audio or speed-dependent steering. Airboat and passive seats have no invented wheels

title: FPS health and ammo on screen
change: Live FPS and frame time appear upper left with health lower left and weapon clip plus reserve lower right
steps: Inspect menus and gameplay. Equip a pistol and fire then reload. Take NPC damage. Switch to a tool and resize the window
expected: FPS updates from real frame time even while paused. Health and ammo follow runtime values. Tools hide ammo
limits: Source-inspired positions only. Native fonts weapon selection armor notifications and complete HUD layout remain open

title: One feedback box with Windows text input

steps: Press F8 and click the box. Type or use your existing Win+H hotkey. Move the caret and try selection paste undo and Save note locally
expected: The complete note and original context save locally without switching tabs or launching an external editor
limits: Windows owns its speech indicator and privacy settings. Dictation focus and DPI behavior need your acceptance. No in-game speech engine is installed

title: Your in-game release checklist

expected: The checklist returns to the previous screen and retains personal checkmarks after restart
